## How to regenerate

```sh
scripts/port-status/run.sh --reference diagnostics            # the checkout at ../Avalonia, or $UPSTREAM
scripts/port-status/run.sh --reference diagnostics --check    # exit 1 when a document is out of date; writes nothing
python3 scripts/port-status/test_gaps.py --reference diagnostics --all   # the test reports, before run.sh
python3 scripts/port-status/port_status.py --reference diagnostics --explain <Project> <File.cs>
```

Inputs: the project list `scripts/api-extract/projects-diagnostics.json`, the extraction `docs/porting/data/diagnostics/upstream-api.json`, `docs/porting/data/diagnostics/path-overrides.toml`, `docs/porting/data/diagnostics/member-waivers.toml` and `docs/porting/data/diagnostics/test-aliases.toml`. Outputs: this directory (`docs/porting/tracking/diagnostics/`) and `docs/porting/data/diagnostics/port-status.json`.
